condition.narrative: Section I.A.1 of Schedule 2 to the Loan Agreement. The Borrower, through the MTR, shall operate and maintain at all times duringProject implementation, the DGPPSE, with structure, functions, and responsibilities acceptable to the Bank, as set forth in theOperational Manual.

Section I.A.2 of Schedule 2 to the Loan Agreement. The Borrower, through the MTR, shall ensure that the DGPPSE is at all timesduring Project implementation adequately staffed with professionals necessary to fulfill its functions.

Section I.B of Schedule 2 to the Loan Agreement. The Borrower, through the MTR, shall make part of the proceeds of the Loanavailable to ADIF on a non-reimbursable basis, under an assistance and execution agreement between the Borrower, through the MTRand ADIF, under terms and conditions approved by the Bank.

title.narrative: Passengers per day on the Belgrano Sur Line

comment.narrative: Even though the number of passengers grew after the pandemic, the exponentially deteriorating railway track conditions, which are due to be rehabilitated, are likely to impact current demand.

title.narrative: Passengers per day on the Belgrano Sur Line

comment.narrative: The deficient track conditions on the Belgrano Sur line result in (i) long travel times and (ii) limited service reliability, which make the train less attractive than other transport alternatives, which explains the current demand levels.
